name: Persian cucumbers
tile_uses: The tomato plate, rice bowls, cucumber yogurt
why_now: Small, seedless, and thin-skinned, Persian cucumbers are at their crispest in summer. They need no peeling and almost no preparation.
buy_this_much: 4–6 cucumbers for one person for the week
price_note: Often one of the least expensive things in the basket. Sold in bags at most grocery stores — good value relative to how far they stretch across the week.

flavor_paths.name: Lime + mint
flavor_paths.description: Sliced, lime, flaky salt, mint. Cool and bright.

flavor_paths.name: In yogurt
flavor_paths.description: Grated into salted Greek yogurt with mint. The cool flavor.

flavor_paths.name: Raw and crunchy
flavor_paths.description: Sliced thin over a rice bowl.

weekend_use: Sliced with mint and lime beside the slow-roasted salmon.
storage: Refrigerate in a loose bag. Use within one week. Best used early in the week.
one_thing_to_learn: Salt briefly before dressing and let the water draw out for a few minutes. The cucumber becomes more concentrated and holds its crunch longer.
